in_hebrew.name: Shirleen

in_hebrew.long_meaning: Shirleen הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old English word 'scir' meaning 'bright, clear, or shining', and the Old French word 'le' meaning 'little' or 'light'. The name Shirleen may have originated as a diminutive of the name Shirley or as a name in its own right, meaning 'gentle song or melody'.
